tasks.label: DEBUG: Attach GDB to ANY crashed/running jackal node
tasks.detail: Smart attach: finds which jackal node is running and attaches GDB to it
tasks.command: source /workspace/devel/setup.bash && echo 'Searching for running jackal nodes...' && PIDS=$(pgrep -f 'jules_ros1_jackalplanner' | tr '\n' ' ') && if [ -z "$PIDS" ]; then echo 'ERROR: No jackal nodes running. Start simulation first!'; exit 1; fi && echo "Found PIDs: $PIDS" && for PID in $PIDS; do CMDLINE=$(cat /proc/$PID/cmdline 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' '); NAMESPACE=$(echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -oP '__ns:=/\K[^[:space:]]+' || echo 'unknown'); echo "  PID $PID -> namespace: /$NAMESPACE"; done && echo '' && read -p 'Enter PID to attach to (or press Enter for first): ' TARGET_PID && if [ -z "$TARGET_PID" ]; then TARGET_PID=$(echo $PIDS | awk '{print $1}'); fi && echo "Attaching to PID: $TARGET_PID" && echo '=== GDB ATTACH SESSION ===' && echo 'Commands:' && echo '  continue (or c)        - Resume execution' && echo '  backtrace (or bt)      - Show current stack' && echo '  thread apply all bt    - Show ALL threads' && echo '  detach                 - Detach without killing' && echo '  quit                   - Exit GDB' && echo '' && sudo gdb -p $TARGET_PID

tasks.label: DEBUG: Enable core dumps and run simulation
tasks.detail: Enable core dump generation, then run simulation. If it crashes, analyze with 'gdb <executable> <core_file>'
tasks.command: ulimit -c unlimited && echo 'Core dumps enabled (unlimited size)' && echo 'Core files will be saved to: /tmp/cores/' && mkdir -p /tmp/cores && echo '/tmp/cores/core.%e.%p.%t' | sudo tee /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern && source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.sh && source /workspace/devel/setup.bash && source /workspace/fix_console.sh && roslaunch bring_up_multi_robot_scenarios ros1_launch_multiple_jack_world_v2.launch

tasks.label: DEBUG: Analyze latest core dump
tasks.detail: Load the most recent core dump file with GDB for post-mortem analysis
tasks.command: CORE_FILE=$(ls -t /tmp/cores/core.* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -z "$CORE_FILE" ]; then echo 'No core dump found in /tmp/cores/'; echo 'Run "DEBUG: Enable core dumps and run simulation" first'; exit 1; fi && echo "Found core dump: $CORE_FILE" && EXEC_PATH=/workspace/devel/lib/mpc_planner_jackalsimulator/jules_ros1_jackalplanner && echo "Executable: $EXEC_PATH" && echo '' && echo '=== CORE DUMP ANALYSIS ===' && echo 'Commands:' && echo '  backtrace (or bt)      - Show crash location' && echo '  thread apply all bt    - Show ALL thread stacks' && echo '  info threads           - List threads (crashed thread marked with *)' && echo '  frame N                - Jump to frame N' && echo '  print variable         - Inspect variable at crash' && echo '  list                   - Show source code' && echo '' && gdb $EXEC_PATH $CORE_FILE
